purpose: Owner-approved overnight-only capture setup and HR-only sleep persistence verification
testScope: Synthetic HR/RR with beat-consistent timestamps, no motion or history. Production IntelligenceEngine must persist an estimated night, resting HR, and HRV, and expose it through allSleepSessions used by SleepView.

hardware.overnightCaptureActivation: Enabled and verified in persisted preferences after normal relaunch

limitations: Synthetic pipeline checks do not validate physiological accuracy or an actual worn night.
The last hardware capture received no readable HR; enabling capture does not itself repair sensor delivery.
The existing overnight-only schedule follows notification quiet hours, default 22:00 to 07:00 local time.
No firmware, authorization, wake-alarm, or database migrations were changed.
